## AI section (filled in by the AI in comments)

This issue is the requirement and the record. The AI posts every proposal and decision here, in this order:

1. Proposed stories, design proposal (with screenshots of the mockups), open questions and the PO's answers.
2. After the PO approves the acceptance criteria: test cases per acceptance criterion (`AC<n>.<m>`, in German and plain language) for PO review.
3. After the PO approves the test cases and gives the go: a pull request starting with `Closes #<this issue>`, so the issue closes when it is merged.
